title: AnalystOutput
description: Structured return for the analista subagent: verdict, calibrated confidence, alternatives considered, recommendation, full reasoning, one-line summary, and optional re-route.

verdict.description: Bottom-line judgment on the proposed course of action.

confidence.description: Calibrated confidence in the verdict (0 = no confidence, 1 = certain).

alternatives_considered.description: The alternatives weighed before reaching the verdict (at least two).

reasoning.description: The analyst's full chain of thought, in English.

re_route_to.description: Optional agent id to send the work to instead (e.g. coder-angular, coder-go, reviewer, architect, tester, explorer).
